scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,green "npm --workspace=@pact/api run dev" "npm --workspace=@pact/api run worker:dev" "npm --workspace=@pact/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@pact/shared run build && npm --workspace=@pact/api run build && npm --workspace=@pact/web run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@pact/shared run test && npm --workspace=@pact/api run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@pact/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@pact/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@pact/web run typecheck
